records.meaningJa: 自信のない・安全でない

records.definitionEn: showing a deep understanding of a subject

records.definitionEn: refusal to obey legitimate authority

records.definitionEn: the capacity for understanding and reasoning

records.definitionEn: easy to use or understand without detailed instruction
